_transcription: ENGLISH half only, CBSE Class 10 Science (086), Series Z1XYW/2 SET-3. 27 page images (cover announces 27 printed pages; last folio 27): idx 0 cover, idx 1 Hindi instructions, idx 2 English instructions + Q1-2; English on EVERY EVEN index 2-26, Hindi on every odd index 3-25. Odd-page tops checked on the contact sheet: all Hindi, and every English page continues exactly where the previous English page stopped (idx 16 ends on Q30's OR and idx 18 opens with Q30(b); idx 18 ends on Q34's OR and idx 20 opens with Q34(b); idx 22 ends on Q37(c)'s OR and idx 24 opens with its alternative), so nothing spills onto an odd page. idx 26 is English (Q39 only). Questions run 1-39 unbroken. Printed instructions confirm sci80: A Q1-20 x1 (Q17-20 Assertion-Reason), B 21-26 x2, C 27-33 x3, D 34-36 x5, E 37-39 x4. Instruction (viii) prints NO count of internal choices, so the roster was built by walking the marking scheme (ms idx 2-10, footer X_086_31/2/3, one set only) for a bare OR: Q23, 25, 29, 30, 34, 35, 37(c), 38(c), 39(c) = 9 alternatives, each confirmed against a printed OR on the paper. Q22, Q24, Q27, Q28, Q32 and Q36 carry parts with NO OR, so each is one row. Sibling of 31/2/1: 43 rows copied byte for byte from it after reading each on this paper's page; 11 rows transcribed fresh (Q2, Q7, Q19, Q22, Q26, Q27, Q28, Q29a, Q29b, Q32, Q36; none of them occurs in any committed 2023 Science paper). No difference found in any shared question, not even a typesetting slip. All 20 Section-A keys are CBSE's own, read off the scheme page image (ms idx 2); each re-derived: all 20 agree. No void, grace or either-of-two note anywhere in the scheme (only the conditional 'Award full marks if data not written but calculations are correct' under Q30(a)). No decimal point printed anywhere on the English pages (the scheme prints raised dots in Q36(b) and Q39).
